item.title: Joint List and Ra'am sign surplus-vote agreement
item.description:
The Joint List and the United Arab List (Ra’am) signed a surplus-vote agreement ahead of the elections in a bid to prevent votes from going to waste.
Under the agreement, the parties pledged to conduct a “fair and clean election campaign" and refrain from smears, defamation and incitement. The agreement will be submitted to the Central Elections Committee after the candidate lists are approved.

item.title: Yamam officer found dead after disappearing while freediving in Haifa
item.description: SFC Itai Parson, 23, disappeared while freediving off Haifa as his family waited nearby; his body was located following an extensive three-day search.

item.title: Kushner: US used fallout from Qatar strike to pressure Israel on Gaza deal
item.description: Trump envoy Jared Kushner says US administration capitalized on Israel's growing diplomatic isolation following failed Doha strike to push Israeli government toward Gaza agreement.

item.title: IDF eliminates two terrorists in Hamas’ engineering unit
item.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Gaza City area and eliminated the terrorists Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, operatives in the engineering unit of Hamas’ military wing.
Recently, the terrorists were involved in the production and development of weapons, advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, and attempted to reconstitute the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated in order to remove the threat they posed.

item.title: Israelis are opening their wallets: NIS 1.196 billion spent on Rosh Hashana eve
item.description:
Automatic Bank Services data: Israelis spent more than NIS 1.196 billion using payment cards on Rosh Hashanah eve, an increase of 3% from last year.
The busiest minute was recorded at 11:52 a.m., with more than 21,800 transactions totaling NIS 3.91 million.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas sniper cell chief who attempted to reconstitute organization's capabilities
item.description:
Yesterday (Thursday), the IDF and ISA struck in the Khan Yunis area and eliminated the terrorist Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda, head of a sniper cell in Hamas’ Rafah Brigade.
The terrorist carried out sniper training across the Gaza Strip aimed at harming Israeli civilians and IDF troops operating in the area of the Yellow Line. Recently, he attempted to reconstitute the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. He was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.
Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munition and aerial surveillance.
